ARC Singapore launches a regional secure-automation network

The new industry body signs MoUs for four country chapters and plans collaboration on trusted automation.

ARC Singapore / PR Newswire ↗5 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Connecting three disciplines

ARC Singapore launched on October 5 to connect AI developers, robotics suppliers, cybersecurity specialists, researchers and enterprise users. Its premise is that decision software, physical machines and connected networks must be assessed together when AI controls work in real environments.

A regional network is planned

The body signed MoUs with chapter leads in Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia and Vietnam. Planned work covers policy input, cross-sector collaboration, digital trust and skills development. First-year working groups include an AI risk framework jointly led by a solution provider and an enterprise user.

Implications for system buyers

For Thai businesses, the potential value is closer regional alignment between automation procurement and security evaluation. However, these agreements do not create binding standards or certify products. Proposed trust baselines and procurement guidance remain development goals whose practical value will depend on published documents and implementation.
